description: Send an openagents.classify.v1 request to the service's /v1/classify and return the report unchanged: results in input order, selections, totals per unit, and usage. This call can use your quota or cost money.

request.description: The openagents.classify.v1 request: v, model, capacity, policy, inputs, and labels, levels, or dimensions.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call. Retries reuse it, so a retry isn't charged twice.

name: classify
title: Classify inputs with a model

description: Choose exactly one label, or no match, for each text. The label probabilities for a text add up to one. Returns the full report in input order; use count_labels if you only need totals.

capacity.description: The capacity tier your API key uses for this model: `shared` unless your account has a dedicated tier.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

labels.description: The labels to choose from: IDs, or {id, description} objects. The model reads each description as the meaning of that label.

min_probability.description: If the top probability is below this value, return no match instead of a label.

model.description: The model to use. If you leave it out, the tool uses the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call. Retries reuse it, so a retry isn't charged twice.

texts.description: The input texts, in the order results preserve.

uncertain_below.description: Mark a result `uncertain` if its top probability is below this value.

name: classify_texts
title: Classify texts into one label

description: Classify the same inputs on several separate dimensions, each with its own mode and its own labels or scoring levels. Returns the full report in input order.

capacity.description: The capacity tier your API key uses for this model: `shared` unless your account has a dedicated tier.

dimensions.description: Named dimensions, each classified separately. A single-label dimension needs labels; multi-label and binary dimensions need labels and the request's threshold; a score dimension needs levels.

labels.description: The labels to choose from: IDs, or {id, description} objects. The model reads each description as the meaning of that label.

inputs.description: The inputs: texts, or {id, text} or {id, record} objects.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

model.description: The model to use. If you leave it out, the tool uses the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call. Retries reuse it, so a retry isn't charged twice.

threshold.description: Required if any dimension is multi-label or binary: the probability a label must reach to be selected.

top_n.description: The most labels to select for each multi-label dimension.

uncertain_below.description: Mark a result `uncertain` if its top probability is below this value.

name: classify_dimensions
title: Classify inputs on named dimensions

description: Get a separate probability for each label on each text; the probabilities don't add up to one. Every label at or above your threshold is selected. Returns the full report in input order.

capacity.description: The capacity tier your API key uses for this model: `shared` unless your account has a dedicated tier.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

labels.description: The labels to choose from: IDs, or {id, description} objects. The model reads each description as the meaning of that label.

model.description: The model to use. If you leave it out, the tool uses the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call. Retries reuse it, so a retry isn't charged twice.

texts.description: The input texts, in the order results preserve.

threshold.description: Required. The probability a label must reach to be selected. There is no default; choose a value that fits your data.

top_n.description: The most labels to select for each input.

uncertain_below.description: Mark a result `uncertain` if, for any label, the more likely of yes or no has a probability below this value.

name: classify_multi_label

name: count_labels
title: Count texts per label

description: Classify texts with one label each, and return the results whose top probability is below `uncertain_below`: the input ID, the selected label, and the top probability, up to `show` items, plus counts by outcome. With `reviewer`, that model classifies the uncertain results again first.

capacity.description: The capacity tier your API key uses for this model: `shared` unless your account has a dedicated tier.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

labels.description: The labels to choose from: IDs, or {id, description} objects. The model reads each description as the meaning of that label.

model.description: The model to use. If you leave it out, the tool uses the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call. Retries reuse it, so a retry isn't charged twice.

reviewer.description: A second model that classifies the uncertain results again. It reviews at most 200 items with at most 400 attempts in 30 seconds, and keeps the original result for any item it can't review.

show.description: How many of the most uncertain items to list. The other inputs are left out of the response.

texts.description: The input texts, in the order results preserve.

uncertain_below.description: Required. Mark a result `uncertain` if its top label probability is below this value.
